CustomField.description: Marks the two anti-fraud wire verification definitions, B2 and I7. Seeds Checklist_Item__c.Is_Wire_Verification__c, which is what Transaction__c.Wire_Open_Risks__c counts after cutover. It replaces the Subject.toLowerCase().contains(anti-fraud) parse in TaskRollupService, which fails silently in the unsafe direction - the metric reads 0 open wire risks on every deal and nothing errors. SEPARATE FROM Is_Critical__c ON PURPOSE: B2 and I7 are both, F12 and J4 are critical but are not wire verifications, so one column cannot serve both.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick only on the anti-fraud wire verification definitions. Drives the open wire risk count on the deal.
CustomField.label: Is Wire Verification
